title: Employee Portal Access Guide
content:
## Portal Login Steps

1. Navigate to https://portal.nexuscorp.io
2. Click [Sign In] and select Okta Connect
3. Enter your corporate email and password
4. Complete MFA verification if prompted

## Common Issues
- Page not loading: Clear browser cache
- Login failed: Check password expiration
- MFA error: Contact IT helpdesk ext. 5555

## Notes
- Okta Connect is the default SSO provider
- Session timeout is 8 hours

title: Hardware Procurement Policy
content:
## Requesting Equipment

1. Submit ticket via ServiceNow
2. Manager approval required
3. Delivery within 3 business days

## Standard Kit
- Laptop: Dell Latitude or MacBook Air
- Monitor: 24-inch HD
- Peripherals: Standard keyboard/mouse

## Returns
- Return all items within 5 days of resignation

title: Remote Work Standards
content:
## Expectations

1. Log into Portal daily (see kb_001)
2. Available on Slack during core hours
3. Weekly team sync via Zoom

## Tools
- Chat: Slack
- Docs: Notion
- Code: GitHub Enterprise

## Network
- Minimum 25Mbps download
- Use wired connection if possible

title: Vacation Request Workflow
content:
## Submitting Leave

1. Log into HRIS
2. Select dates
3. Manager approval

## Balances
- Accrual: 1.5 days per month
- Carryover: Max 5 days

## Notes
- Blackout dates apply in Q4

title: Account Security Standards
content:
## Password Rules
- Length: 14 characters minimum
- Complexity: Upper, lower, number, symbol
- Rotation: Every 60 days

## MFA Requirements
- Mandatory for all systems
- App: Microsoft Authenticator
- Backup: SMS code

## Lockout
- 3 failed attempts = 15 min lock

title: SSO Provider Migration Notice
content:
## Urgent Update

Nexus Corp is migrating from Okta Connect to Azure Entra ID effective March 15, 2026.

## Action Required
1. Do not use Okta Connect after migration date
2. Download Azure Authenticator
3. Login via https://portal.nexuscorp.io using Azure SSO

## Priority
This notice supersedes kb_001. Contact ext. 5555 for issues.

title: Portal Troubleshooting Checklist
content:
## Common Errors

- 403 Forbidden: Check permissions (see kb_003)
- 500 Error: Wait 5 mins and retry
- SSO Loop: Clear cookies

## References
- For login steps see kb_001
- For security policy see kb_005
- For migration info see kb_006
